paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English — dono allowed. Mixed bhi chalega. Paper mein dono versions chhape hote hain.

question_types_in_exam.summary: UP Board Class 12 Geography mein 5 types: MCQ (1 mark), VSA (2 marks, 20 words), SA (4 marks, 50 words), LA (6 marks, 150 words), Map (1 mark per item, 5 items each from India + World).

types.mostly_from: Sare 8 attempt karo — no negative marking. Elimination se answer nikalo. Har saal 2-3 questions repeat hote hain (primary/secondary/tertiary activity identify, highest/lowest density state, human geography concept).
types.notes: Sare 8 attempt karo — no negative marking. Elimination se answer nikalo. Har saal 2-3 questions repeat hote hain (primary/secondary/tertiary activity identify, highest/lowest density state, human geography concept).

types.mostly_from: Definition + 1 example ya 2 points. Zyada mat likho — 20 words limit strict hai. Examiners ko keyword dikhna chahiye. Sex ratio, human resource, clustered settlements, migration — ye har saal aate hain.
types.notes: Definition + 1 example ya 2 points. Zyada mat likho — 20 words limit strict hai. Examiners ko keyword dikhna chahiye. Sex ratio, human resource, clustered settlements, migration — ye har saal aate hain.

types.mostly_from: Intro + 3-4 points + conclusion. 'Vivechna kijiye' / 'Vibhed kijiye' / 'Ullekh kijiye' type questions. Points numbered form mein likhna better.
types.notes: Intro + 3-4 points + conclusion. 'Vivechna kijiye' / 'Vibhed kijiye' / 'Ullekh kijiye' type questions. Points numbered form mein likhna better.

types.mostly_from: Intro paragraph + heading-wise points + diagram/sketch map + conclusion. Human Geography nature-scope aur Iron ore/Petroleum distribution — ye LA mein sabse common. Dono OR options padh ke jo easier lage wo attempt karo.
types.notes: Intro paragraph + heading-wise points + diagram/sketch map + conclusion. Human Geography nature-scope aur Iron ore/Petroleum distribution — ye LA mein sabse common. Dono OR options padh ke jo easier lage wo attempt karo.

types.mostly_from: Supplied outline map paper mein hota hai — ANSWER SHEET mein NAHI. Map ko fadke, usmein symbol + naam likhke, answer book ke saath mazbooti se attach karna hai. Symbol saaf aur naam spelling sahi — dono ke liye alag-alag half mark.
types.notes: Supplied outline map paper mein hota hai — ANSWER SHEET mein NAHI. Map ko fadke, usmein symbol + naam likhke, answer book ke saath mazbooti se attach karna hai. Symbol saaf aur naam spelling sahi — dono ke liye alag-alag half mark.

paper_pattern.note: UP Board Geography theory paper = 70 marks, 26 questions, 3 hr 15 min (15 min reading). Pattern 2022-2026 tak consistent raha hai — koi major change nahi.

chapters.name: Human Geography — Nature and Scope (Manav Bhugol — Prakriti evam Vishay Kshetra)
topics: Manav ka prakritikaran aur prakriti ka manavikaran
Determinism vs Possibilism vs Neo-determinism (Stop-and-Go Determinism)
Scholars: E.C. Semple (Determinism), Vidal de la Blache (Possibilism), Griffith Taylor (Neo-determinism/Stop-and-Go), Jean Brunhes, Ratzel, Huntington
Fields and sub-fields of human geography
Approaches: Areal differentiation, Quantitative revolution, Spatial organisation, Exploration and description

chapters.name: World Population — Distribution, Density and Growth (Vishva Jansankhya)
topics: Jansankhya vitran ke pattern — geographical, economic, social-cultural factors
Jansankhya ghanatva (density) — formula: total population / total area
Jansankhya vitran ko prabhavit karne wale karak (geographical, economic, social-cultural, demographic)
Jansankhya vriddhi ke ghatak — birth rate, death rate, migration

chapters.name: Human Development (Manav Vikas)
topics: Approaches to human development: Income approach, Welfare approach, Basic needs approach, Capability approach
HDI measurement — Life expectancy + Education + GNI per capita
Dr. Mahbub-ul-Haq and Prof. Amartya Sen ka contribution

chapters.name: Primary Activities (Prathmik Kriyaayein)
topics: Hunting and gathering, Pastoralism (nomadic herding + commercial livestock rearing)
Agriculture types — Subsistence (intensive + primitive), Plantation, Mixed, Commercial grain, Dairy, Mediterranean, Market gardening/Truck farming, Co-operative, Collective
Plantation crops: Tea, Coffee, Rubber, Sugarcane (Malaysia=rubber, Brazil=coffee)

chapters.name: Secondary Activities (Dwitiyak Kriyaayein)
topics: Manufacturing — characteristics, specialisation of skills, production methods
Factors of industrial location — raw material, market, labour, power, transport, capital
Classification of industries — size based, raw material based, output based, ownership based

chapters.name: Tertiary and Quaternary Activities (Tratiyak aur Chaturthyak Kriyakalap)
topics: Types of tertiary — trade/commerce, transport, communication, services
Tourism — tourist regions, attractions, medical tourism (India for overseas patients)
Quaternary activities — knowledge sector (R&D, info processing)

chapters.name: Transport and Communication (Parivahan evam Sanchar)
topics: Rail transport — Trans-continental railways (Trans-Siberian, Trans-Canadian, Trans-Australian, Orient Express)
Water transport — important sea routes, inland waterways

chapters.name: International Trade (Antarrashtriya Vyapar)
topics: Basis — difference in national resources, population factors, stage of economic development, extent of foreign investment, transport
Ports — types (industrial, commercial, comprehensive, inland, out, oil, naval, fishing) and gateways of international trade
Land-locked harbours (e.g., Vishakhapatnam is land-locked in India)

chapters.name: Population — Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition (Bharat: Jansankhya)
topics: Distribution, density, growth of population in India
Smallest and largest religious groups (Smallest = Jain per 2011 census)

chapters.name: Human Settlements (Manav Bastiyaan)
topics: Rural settlements — types (clustered, semi-clustered, hamleted, dispersed) and distribution
Dispersed settlements NOT in: Ganga plains, Himalayan lower valleys, arid Rajasthan (found in: NE forests, hills)

chapters.name: Land Resources and Agriculture (Bhoo-sansadhan tatha Krishi)
topics: Food crops — Wheat, Rice, Jowar, Bajra, Maize, Pulses (Chana), Oilseeds
Agricultural development in India, NMSA (National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture)
Farmer portal of India, Problems of Indian agriculture

chapters.name: Water Resources (Jal Sansadhan)
topics: Water resources of India — surface water, ground water, lagoons and backwaters
Water quality deterioration, water pollution causes and prevention
Water conservation and management — recycling, reuse
National Water Policy 2012, Jal Kranti Abhiyan 2015-16
Four sources of surface water: rivers, lakes, ponds, tanks

chapters.name: Mineral and Energy Resources (Khanij tatha Urja Sansadhan)
topics: Types of minerals — metallic (ferrous: iron ore, manganese / non-ferrous: bauxite, copper), non-metallic (mica)
Iron ore — distribution (Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Karnataka)
Coal — Jharkhand (Jharia, Bokaro), Chhattisgarh, Odisha, West Bengal
Petroleum — Assam (Digboi, Naharkatiya), Gujarat (Ankleshwar), Bombay High (offshore)
Non-conventional: Nuclear (Tarapur=1st, Kalpakkam, Narora, Rawatbhata/Rana Pratap Sagar, Kaiga, Kakrapar), Solar, Wind, Tidal, Geothermal, Bio-energy

chapters.name: Planning and Sustainable Development in Indian Context (Niyojan aur Sustainable Vikas)
topics: Case study: Bharmaur — Integrated Tribal Development Programme (ITDP)
Case study: Indira Gandhi Canal Command Area

pyq_analysis_2022_to_2026.summary: 5 saal ke papers (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026-CP) analysis se pattern ekdum clear hai. 60-70% questions repeat concept/topic par based hote hain.
most_repeated_MCQ_topics: Human geography concept (determinism/possibilism/neo-determinism) — har saal Q1
Oil field state (Assam) / Bombay High — 4/5 years
most_repeated_SA_topics: Population distribution factors (world) — every year in some form
most_repeated_LA_topics: Human Geography Nature and Scope — 3/5 years (2022, 2024, 2026)
high_probability_2026_predictions: MCQ: Ek human geo concept + ek density state + ek oil/coal state + ek port + ek activity type — all confirmed in 2026-CP already
LA Q23: Human Geography Nature-Scope OR Industry Location (confirmed 2026-CP)
LA Q24: Land Use Change OR Urban Waste Management (confirmed 2026-CP)
India Map: State with lowest population, Aravalli range, Mahanadi, SE state, its capital (confirmed 2026-CP)
World Map: Panama, Nile, Australian port, European grape region, London (confirmed 2026-CP)

important_formula_sheets.note: Not typically applicable for Geography (humanities subject).

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: UP Board Geography CBSE se thoda simpler hai — par presentation strict hai. Map work 10/70 marks scoring opportunity.
most_scoring_sections: Easy — 6-7 correct easily if concepts clear. Repeat hote hain har saal.
Easy to Medium — Definitions aur 2-line explanations. Yaad kar lo toh full marks.
Easy — agar practice ki ho. Har saal same type ke items: density state, crop state, port, canal, capital, river.
most_difficult_sections: Medium to Medium-Hard — 150 words mein nature-scope, industry distribution, sustainable development. Diagram zaroor banao.

tips: Map questions SABSE LAST mein karo — taaki answer book ke saath attach karne mein dikkat na ho
MCQ 10 minute mein nikal lo — jaldi start karo for confidence boost
VSA mein 2-3 line se zyada nahi — words waste mat karo
LA mein diagram/sketch map zaroor banao — even rough one milta hai extra marks
Section A ke LA (Q23) mein 'Human Geography Nature and Scope' practice karke jao — 3 saal se aaya hai
Section B ke LA (Q24) mein Iron Ore / Petroleum / Manganese distribution ek pakka karo — India ka map sketch with shading
OR option padh ke jo easier lage wo attempt karo — dono dekh ke decide karo
Map items: India ke liye 20 common locations yaad — World ke liye 20 common locations yaad. Dono sheet me alag-alag practice karo
Hinglish chalega — koi term English mein aata hai toh wohi likho (Demographic Transition, HDI, GIS — English mein hi)
Answer sheet pe writing clean honi chahiye — UP Board strict hai presentation ke liye
150 word LA mein 2-3 sub-headings banao — examiner ko visual structure dikhta hai

time_allocation.note: Paper padho. OR options mein se easier choose karo. Map items ka mental plan banao (kaunsa state kahan hai).
8 MCQ, har ek ~1 minute. Jaldi nikal lo. Confused ho toh elimination use karo — no negative marking.
8 VSA, har ek ~3 min. 20 words strict — 2-3 lines maximum. Keyword-based answer.
6 SA, har ek ~8 min. 50 words — 5-6 lines. Intro + 3-4 points + ek line conclusion.
2 LA, har ek ~20 min. 150 words + sketch map/diagram. Heading structure use karo.
Dono maps — pencil se symbol + pen se naam. Map ko answer book ke saath strong staple.
Map attachment check, question numbers check, roll number check.

targets.strategy: Sare 8 MCQ (8 marks, no negative) + 5-6 VSA (10-12 marks) + 1 easy SA (4 marks) + India map sare 5 items (5 marks). Total = 27-29 marks. Safe pass.
focus_areas: MCQ — sare 8 attempt karo, elimination se
VSA ke easy topics — Sex ratio, Human Resource, Clustered Settlements, Migration, Metallic minerals
India map — Lucknow, Assam, Jharkhand, Rajasthan (IG Canal), Vishakhapatnam — ye 5 yaad kar lo guaranteed 5 marks
World map — Panama, Nile, Tokyo, Sahara, Brazil — guaranteed 5 more

targets.strategy: MCQ (8) + VSA all 8 (16) + SA 4-5 (16-20) + LA 1 easy (6) + Map both (10) = 56+ easy.
focus_areas: All named scholars: E.C. Semple, Vidal de la Blache, Griffith Taylor, Amartya Sen, Mahbub-ul-Haq
Iron ore, petroleum, manganese distribution — 3 state-wise tables yaad karo
Population distribution factors (world + India) — both LA and SA level

targets.strategy: Sab kuch attempt — MCQ (8) + VSA (16) + SA all 6 (24) + LA both (12) + Map both (10) = 70.
focus_areas: All scholars and their concepts — MCQ Q1 always from this
All LA topics practiced with diagrams and sketch maps
Both India and World map items — 40+ locations
Case studies — Bharmaur, Indira Gandhi Canal, Ahmednagar watershed, Namami Gange
Demographic transition 4 stages, HDI approaches 4 types, Land use 9 classifications — in teeno lists ko ratt lo

exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 15 minute reading time milta hai (paper padhne ke liye) — is time mein likhna allowed nahi.

answer_sheet_rules: map_attachment: Supplied map ko question paper se fadke, usmein symbols + naam likhke, answer book ke saath mazbooti se (mazbooti se = strong staple ya tie) attach karna COMPULSORY hai. Agar attach nahi kiya toh 10 marks ka nuksaan.
sequence_note: Question ka sequence follow karna zaroori nahi — MCQ pehle bhi attempt kar sakte ho, Map pehle bhi. Bas har answer ke upar question number clearly likho.
mcq_attempt_all: Sare 8 MCQ attempt karo — no negative marking.
map_item_split: Har map item ka 1 mark = 1/2 (sahi symbol/location) + 1/2 (sahi naam). Dono sahi hone chahiye for full mark.
spelling_of_places: Place names ki spelling sahi honi chahiye — Mormugao, Vishakhapatnam, Marmagao jaise naam practice kar lo. Galat spelling se 1/2 mark cut.

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] pencil_use: Maps, sketch maps, diagrams ke liye pencil use karo — clean dikhta hai aur galti hone pe erase kar sakte ho. map_symbols_note: Map mein symbols pencil se bana ke, naam blue/black pen se likhna sabse safe.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: sketch_maps_and_diagrams: Instructions mein likha hai 'Illustrate your answers with suitable sketch maps and diagrams' — SA aur LA mein jahan possible ho, small sketch banao. Extra marks milte hain. headings_and_subheadings: LA (150 words) mein heading-subheading structure use karo — examiner ko points clearly dikhne chahiye. word_limit_respect: 20/50/150 words limit ko respect karo. Zyada likhne se time waste aur neat presentation nahi rahega. hindi_or_english: Dono languages allowed. Mixed bhi chalega — term English mein (e.g., 'Demographic Transition') aur explanation Hindi mein — common practice hai. partial_marking: True partial_marking_note: SA/LA mein partial marks milte hain — ek point galat ho toh baaki points ke marks milenge.
